OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH
Up to 800,000 Shares of Common Stock of
HALLOWELL MANUFACTURING CO.
at $22.00 Per Share in Cash

The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on November 6, 2026, unless extended.

Hallowell Manufacturing Co. is offering to purchase for cash up to 800,000 shares of its common stock at a purchase price of $22.00 per share, net to the seller in cash.

If more than 800,000 Shares are validly tendered and not properly withdrawn prior to the Expiration Date, we will purchase Shares on a pro rata basis from all tendering shareholders, in proportion to the number of Shares tendered by each. There is no odd lot priority in this Offer, and holders of fewer than 100 Shares will be subject to proration on the same basis as all other holders.

Shares may be withdrawn at any time prior to the Expiration Date.
